name: Sill
title: Sill: free Duet alternative
hook: Duet charges you four bucks a month to put your Mac on your iPad. This app does it for free.
job: Puts your Mac on your iPad

features.intro: It puts any Mac window on your iPad.
features.say: Live, with touch, Apple Pencil, a trackpad and keys.
Hold it upright for laptop mode, with a trackpad and keys below.
Launch any Mac app from your iPad.

caption:
Duet charges $3.99/month to put your Mac on your iPad. Sill does it for free 📲

✅ Any Mac window, live on your iPhone or iPad
✅ Touch, Apple Pencil, trackpad and keyboard
✅ Laptop mode + launch any Mac app from your iPad
✅ No account, no servers, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Mac · iPhone · iPad
ℹ️ Two free apps: Sill for Mac (download or Homebrew) plus Sill on the App Store for iPhone/iPad. Needs an Apple silicon Mac on macOS 14+.
